ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels on the lateral lobes and 35% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central peduncle region and perimeter margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity zone forms a solid black contiguous mass extending from the base to the median notch. Lateral lobes contain high-intensity white geometric fields bounded by a continuous 10-20 pixel-wide black margin along the trailing edge. Transition zones exhibit high-frequency mottling/speckling between the dark core and white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical bounding box of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe exhibits high-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks/valleys) along the distal two-thirds of the trailing edge. Left lobe displays a smoother, lower-amplitude topographical profile with localized jagged peaks near the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave curvature along the superior trailing edge, transitioning to convex curves at the leading edge/tips, creating an upward-tapered wing-like profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Primary linear disruption: a prominent dark diagonal streak (approx. 45-degree angle) on the lower-left high-intensity field. Secondary disruption: a horizontal dark streak on the upper-right high-intensity field near the margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized dark linear markings on both lobes that break the contiguous white pigmentation; distinct dark vertical indentation/marking on the far left distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive peripheral pixel noise caused by water spray and splashing along the lower boundary where the fluke meets the water surface.
